name: Law2_SCG_KnKsPhys_KnKsLaw
description:
Law for linear compression, without cohesion and Mohr-Coulomb plasticity surface.

.. note::
 This law uses ScGeom; there is also functionally equivalent Law2_Dem3DofGeom_FrictPhys_Basic, which uses Dem3DofGeom (sphere-box interactions are not implemented for the latest).

attributes.name: Talesnick
attributes.description: Use contact law developed for validation against model test

attributes.name: allowBreakage
attributes.description: Allow cohesion to break. Once broken, cohesion = 0

attributes.name: allowViscousAttraction
attributes.description: Whether to allow attractive forces due to viscous damping

attributes.name: initialOverlapDistance
attributes.description: Initial overlap distance, defining the offset distance for tension overlap, i.e. negative overlap.

attributes.name: neverErase
attributes.description: Keep interactions even if particles go away from each other (only in case another constitutive law is in the scene, e.g.

attributes.name: traceEnergy
attributes.description: Define the total energy dissipated in plastic slips at all contacts.

methods.name: elasticEnergy
methods.description: Compute and return the total elastic energy in all "FrictPhys" contacts. Computed only if Law2_SCG_KnKsPhys_KnKsLaw::traceEnergy is true.

methods.name: initPlasticDissipation
methods.description: Initialize cummulated plastic dissipation to a value (0 by default).

methods.name: normDampDissip
methods.description: Total energy dissipated in normal viscous damping. Computed only if Law2_SCG_KnKsPhys_KnKsLaw::traceEnergy is true.

methods.name: plasticDissipation
methods.description: Total energy dissipated in plastic slips at all FrictPhys contacts. Computed only if Law2_SCG_KnKsPhys_KnKsLaw::traceEnergy is true.

methods.name: ratioSlidingContacts
methods.description: Return the ratio between the number of contacts sliding to the total number at a given time.

methods.name: shearDampDissip
methods.description: Total energy dissipated in shear viscous damping. Computed only if Law2_SCG_KnKsPhys_KnKsLaw::traceEnergy is true.
